articles.title: Gemini strikes Apex deal to widen prediction markets reach
articles.snippet: The planned tie-up would make Gemini the exclusive CFTC-regulated venue for crypto event contracts offered through Apex’s futures commission merchant.

articles.title: Crypto roars back as bitcoin posts its second-best week since early 2021
articles.snippet: Treasury buybacks, ETF inflows and a weaker dollar ignite crypto’s breakout.

articles.title: Fake Crypto AML Checkers Are Trying to Drain Users' Wallets
articles.snippet: Scammers are impersonating crypto compliance services to trick users into approving transactions that could put their assets at risk.
